text: Collection hit compatibility errors with Python 3.12. I’ll rerun each suite separately and let pytest continue past collection errors so I can count the tests that do pass.

arguments.command: export PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH="$PWD/host:$PWD/consumer"; (cd host && python -m pytest -p no:cacheprovider --doctest-modules --continue-on-collection-errors -q boltons tests); (cd consumer && python -m pytest -p no:cacheprovider --doctest-modules --continue-on-collection-errors -q glom); git status --short
